People: Apolonia Helena Massalska (author, Wikidata Q9287278), died 1815; Lucien Perey (editor, Wikidata Q21401578), died 1914; Laura Ensor (translator, Wikidata Q120016137), died 1920. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Massalska, Apolonia Helena, 1763-1815; Perey, Lucien, 1825-1914 [Editor]; Ensor, Laura, 1840-1920 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Memoirs Of The Princesse De Ligne Vol Ii, 1887, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.66423. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 75%, 66%, 62% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Apolonia Helena Massalska, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
